title: Review insecure jwt decode
why: JWT decoding without an explicit algorithm policy can accept unintended token configurations.
suggestion: Pass a fixed algorithms allowlist and keep signature verification enabled.
limitations: Executable single-line and multiline jwt.decode calls are inspected for a direct algorithms argument and explicitly disabled signature verification. Direct keyword names use the executable lexical view: comments and quoted examples do not establish calls or algorithm policy, and comments between keyword tokens do not hide an explicit algorithms argument.

Fresh local dict(...) or dictionary-literal kwargs can establish a fixed nonempty HS/RS/ES/PS algorithm allowlist. Rebinding, aliases, mutation, scope changes, additional expansions, dynamic options, and observed dict shadowing invalidate this proof; simple optional issuer assignment is supported.
Arbitrary kwargs, interprocedural data flow, aliased decoders, and diagnostic-only uses of signature-disabled decoding are not resolved.
